prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the recent price trend: momentum scores only 26 of 100 against the comparison pool. Other areas on this side: price behaviour, risk, growth.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 8 points in favour and 8 against give an even split. The pool score is 68 of 100. The side that carries most weight is cash flow and the balance sheet.
